headline: A House resolution to impeach President Trump over how ICE and CBP operate was tabled or sent back to committee and did not pass.
what_it_does: This resolution would have impeached President Donald Trump for "high crimes and misdemeanors." It contained one article of impeachment. That article charged that the President abused his powers by allowing ICE and CBP, the federal immigration and border agencies, to act in ways that violate the First, Fourth, and Fifth Amendments while undermining oversight by the courts. If the House had adopted it, the case would have gone to the Senate for a trial.

who_it_affects.how: He would have been formally impeached by the House and faced a Senate trial that could have removed him from office.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP)
who_it_affects.how: Their actions were the basis of the charge, though the resolution itself would not have changed their rules or powers.
They would have been required to hold a trial and vote on whether to remove the President.
